summary: Principal Financial Group filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026 reporting entry into an Amended and Restated Five-Year Credit Facility among the Company, wholly-owned subsidiary Principal Financial Services, Inc. and borrower Principal Life Insurance Company, with a bank syndicate led by Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The facility refinances the October 18, 2022 revolving credit facility, permits borrowings up to $900,000,000 (accordion to $1,300,000,000), matures September 9, 2031 with two one-year extension options, and carries revised pricing and covenant terms. No borrowings are currently outstanding. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation.
